punchline: Thirty-nine students rated the same astrology page as a very good description of themselves.
thirty_sec: In the late 1940s Bertram Forer gave 39 students personality sketches supposedly written for each of them. All received the same text from a newsstand astrology book, and they rated it about 4.3 out of 5.
question: Which description of you did you accept quickly because it flattered you?
key_contrast: The warm feeling that a description fits, versus asking whether it would fit nearly everyone.
